d: Company Description The Brit Nurse Home Health Care Center LLC provides trusted, professionally trained nurses for home-based healthcare services across the UAE. The center focuses on delivering safe, high-quality care to individuals in the comfort of their homes, supporting patients with a wide range of medical and personal care needs. Services are tailored to each patient’s condition and preferences, promoting dignity, independence, and well-being. The organization values professionalism, compassion, and reliability, offering nurses a supportive environment to practice patient-centered care.

Role Description The Home Health Nurse is a full-time, on-site role based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, providing direct nursing care in patients’ homes. Responsibilities include assessing patient health status, administering medications and treatments, managing wound care, and monitoring vital signs and symptoms. The nurse will coordinate care plans, collaborate with physicians and other healthcare professionals, and educate patients and families on disease management, medication adherence, and preventive care. Daily tasks also involve documenting care accurately, maintaining infection control standards, and ensuring safety during home visits. The role requires flexibility to travel to patient residences, strong communication skills, and a commitment to delivering compassionate, culturally sensitive care.
q: Strong clinical foundation in Nursing and Medicine, with the ability to assess, plan, implement, and evaluate patient care.
Demonstrated experience in Home Care and Patient Care, including providing holistic support in residential settings.
Proficiency in Wound Care, including dressing changes, infection control, and monitoring healing progress.
Valid nursing license/registration in the UAE or eligibility to obtain one, with relevant nursing degree or diploma.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust with patients and families from diverse backgrounds.
Ability to work independently, manage time and caseloads, and adapt to changing patient needs in the community.
Basic proficiency in electronic medical records and documentation; fluency in English required, Arabic or other language skills are an advantage.
Previous home health or community nursing experience is preferred; current certifications in BLS/CPR are beneficial.
